
<br>
**3. import data**
```{r import, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#import annotated reference transcriptome
egg <- read_xlsx("/polyA_eggnog_annotations.xlsx")

#import overall up- and down regulation files (across treatments)
intersect_up <- read_xlsx("upregulated_in_xe.xlsx")
intersect_down <- read_xlsx("downregulated_in_xe.xlsx")
```

<br>
**4. Creating COG category count tables**<br>
Now we will compare the abundance of genes in the results files belonging to a set of overarching processes to their respective abundances in the reference transcriptome to determine processes that are significantly more affected by the presence of bacteria.
```{r count tables,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

#first we determine the abundance of respective cog categories in the background dataset (reference transcriptome)
ref_cog <- data.frame(Column_With_Letters = egg$COG_category)

# Function to count occurrences of each letter
count_letters <- function(string) {
  # Convert string to uppercase to make counts case-insensitive
  string <- toupper(string)
  # Split the string into individual letters
  letters <- unlist(strsplit(string, ""))
  # Count occurrences of each letter
  letter_counts <- table(letters)
  # Convert to data frame
  data.frame(letter = names(letter_counts), count = as.numeric(letter_counts), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

letter_counts_list <- lapply(ref_cog$Column_With_Letters, count_letters) #apply function
total_counts <- do.call(rbind, letter_counts_list) # gather data

# Combine counts from all elements into a single data frame
total_counts <- total_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(letter) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count))

total_counts <- total_counts[2:25,] #remove not annotated symbol "-"
total_counts <- dplyr::rename(total_counts, "COG_category" = letter) 
cog_processes <- read_xlsx("cog_categories.xlsx") #import cog categories
total_counts <- left_join(total_counts, cog_processes, by="COG_category")
total_counts <- group_by(total_counts, process)
total_counts <- mutate(total_counts, rel_cog = count/sum(count))


#now lets calculate the same for our up- and down regulated datasets

#upregulated
up_cog <- data.frame(Column_With_Letters = intersect_up$COG_category)
letter_counts_list <- lapply(up_cog$Column_With_Letters, count_letters)
up_total_counts <- do.call(rbind, letter_counts_list)

up_total_counts <- up_total_counts %>%
  group_by(letter) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count))

up_total_counts <- up_total_counts[2:22,] #remove not annotated symbol "-"
up_total_counts <- dplyr::rename(up_total_counts, "COG_category" = letter) 
up_total_counts <- left_join(up_total_counts, cog_processes, by="COG_category")
up_total_counts <- group_by(up_total_counts, process)
up_total_counts <- mutate(up_total_counts, rel_cog = count/sum(count))


#downregulated
down_cog <- data.frame(Column_With_Letters = intersect_down$COG_category)
letter_counts_list <- lapply(down_cog$Column_With_Letters, count_letters)
down_total_counts <- do.call(rbind, letter_counts_list)

down_total_counts <- down_total_counts %>%
  group_by(letter) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count))

down_total_counts <- down_total_counts[2:22,] #remove not annotated symbol "-"
down_total_counts <- dplyr::rename(down_total_counts, "COG_category" = letter) 
down_total_counts <- left_join(down_total_counts, cog_processes, by="COG_category")
down_total_counts <- group_by(down_total_counts, process)
down_total_counts <- mutate(down_total_counts, rel_cog = count/sum(count))
```

<br>
**5. plotting metabolism**
```{r plot metabolism,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

#metabolism

ref_met <- dplyr::filter(total_counts, process == "metabolism")
up_met <- dplyr::filter(up_total_counts, process == "metabolism")
down_met <- dplyr::filter(down_total_counts, process == "metabolism")

ref_met <- ref_met[,c(1,4)]
up_met <- up_met[,c(1,4)]
down_met <- down_met[,c(1,4)]


ref_met <- spread(ref_met, key = COG_category, value = rel_cog)
up_met <- spread(up_met, key = COG_category, value = rel_cog)
down_met <- spread(down_met, key = COG_category, value = rel_cog)


ref_met <- mutate(ref_met, group = "reference")
up_met <- mutate(up_met, group = "up_xe")
down_met <- mutate(down_met, group = "down_xe")


ref_met <- ref_met[,c(9,1:8)]
up_met <- up_met[,c(9,1:8)]
down_met <- down_met[,c(9,1:8)]


met <- rbind(ref_met, up_met, down_met)

library(qualpalr)
library(viridis)

p_metabolism <- ggradar(
  met, 
  values.radar = c("0", "0.1", "0.25"),
  grid.min = 0, grid.mid = 0.1, grid.max = 0.25,
  # Polygons
  group.line.width = 1, 
  group.point.size = 4,
  # Background and grid lines
  background.circle.colour = "white",
  gridline.mid.colour = "grey",
  legend.position = "left"
)
p_metabolism

#ggsave("met_radar.pdf", p_metabolism, device = "pdf", width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

```

<br>
**8. statistical testing**<br>
Formula:<br>
x <- "count of specific process within the test group (e.g. amino acid metabolism within Arctic)"
m <- "count of specific process in the background data set (e.g. amino acid metabolism count all Orthogroups)"
n <- "count of all specific processes in the background data set (e.g. metabolism count all Orthogroups)” - m
k <- "count of all specific processes within the test group (e.g. metabolism count within Arctic)"
pval_delpleted <- phyper(x,m,n,k,lower.tail = TRUE)
pval_enriched <- phyper(x-1,m,n,k,lower.tail = FALSE)

```{r statistics of enrichment,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
total_counts_copy <- total_counts
up_total_counts_copy <- up_total_counts
up_total_counts_copy <- dplyr::rename(up_total_counts_copy, "counts_up" = count)
down_total_counts_copy <- down_total_counts
down_total_counts_copy <- dplyr::rename(down_total_counts_copy, "counts_down" = count)

df <- left_join(total_counts_copy, up_total_counts_copy, by = "COG_category")
df <- left_join(df, down_total_counts_copy, by = "COG_category")
df <- df[,c(1:3,5,8)]
df$counts_up[is.na(df$counts_up)] <- 0
df$counts_down[is.na(df$counts_down)] <- 0

df <- group_by(df, process.x)
df <- mutate(df, sum_counts = sum(count), up_sum_counts = sum(counts_up), down_sum_counts = sum(counts_down))
df <- mutate(df, up_pval_depleted = phyper(counts_up, count, sum_counts, up_sum_counts, lower.tail = TRUE))
df <- mutate(df, up_pval_enriched = phyper(counts_up - 1, count, sum_counts, up_sum_counts, lower.tail = FALSE))
df <- mutate(df, down_pval_depleted = phyper(counts_down, count, sum_counts, down_sum_counts, lower.tail = TRUE))
df <- mutate(df, down_pval_enriched = phyper(counts_down - 1, count, sum_counts, down_sum_counts, lower.tail = FALSE))
df <- df[,c(1,4:5,9:12)]

#cutoff processes with less than 5 genes
df$up_pval_depleted <- ifelse(df$counts_up<5, paste("NA"), df$up_pval_depleted)
df$up_pval_enriched <- ifelse(df$counts_up<5, paste("NA"), df$up_pval_enriched)
df$down_pval_depleted <- ifelse(df$counts_down<5, paste("NA"), df$down_pval_depleted)
df$down_pval_enriched <- ifelse(df$counts_down<5, paste("NA"), df$down_pval_enriched)
```

```{r subsetting results, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
intersect_up_sub <- dplyr::filter(intersect_up, COG_category == "M" | COG_category == "O" | COG_category == "L" | COG_category == "B" | COG_category == "J" | COG_category == "F" | COG_category == "I" )
#write_xlsx( intersect_up_sub, "signif_processes_up.xlsx")

#significant COG Categories in the downregulated intersection of all treatments
```
